name: New Kitchenmate UV (Undersink)
summary: ZeroB Kitchenmate is a sleek, wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for modern kitchens. It features a 4-stage purification system with an 11W UV lamp, a 5-micron sediment filter, and bacteriostatic activated carbon to help remove impurities and protect against bacteria and viruses.
intro: ZeroB Kitchenmate is a sleek, wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for modern kitchens. It features a 4-stage purification system with an 11W UV lamp, a 5-micron sediment filter, and bacteriostatic activated carbon to help remove impurities and protect against bacteria and viruses. Ideal for municipal water with TDS below 500 ppm, it delivers purified water at up to 1 litre per minute while preserving the natural taste of water.
features: Retains Crucial Natural Minerals & Healthy Taste
